test_nested_message_descriptor: test that nested message descriptors match the field message_type in protobuf generated code
test_enum_values: test module-level and nested enum values are correctly generated by the protobuf compiler
test_extreme_default_values: test that protobuf messages handle infinity and NaN default values for float and double fields
test_extension_behavior: test extension containing_type, extension_scope, and is_extension properties on protobuf descriptors
test_symbol_database_lookup: test that symbol_database.Default().GetSymbol resolves protobuf message types, enums, and files by full name
